notes.title: The Lost Bloodline Demo (Gameplay)
notes.content:
In This Stream we are going to play the demo and talk about the next upcoming events of our game The Lost Bloodline

https://youtu.be/1BzppACl_aw

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930055/5a0c475470c3aabd8ef5023f6793fd2f8ac7cfe2.png



Make Sure To Wishlist The Game 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2128320/The_Lost_Bloodline/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930055/8cee06d6b8fc6b443a8c88ec39d1bb773d6b6146.png


Steam Fest
Hello everyone, we are 90 miles studios, a small indie game company. We are currently developing a game called The Lost Bloodline
A 3rd person action-adventure game, set in a medieval world.
Today we are presenting our playable demo as part of the Steam Next Fest.
The first Title screen shows the language selection menu, where we have added 5 languages including Spanish, English, Russian, Portuguese and Chinese
Then we added the gamma correction, a very common option where each player can change the brightness of the game to their liking
It should be noted that this is a demo, does not represent the final result of the game..
As we could see in the cinematic, our character Dan, must rescue his partner Herodes, who has been kidnapped by Ibarum's King soldiers. The one who helps him is Namik, the royal adviser of the former King.
As we were saying through our networks we have added different steam gift card keys throughout the demo
We would like to clarify that it will not be easy to find them but we want to encourage exploration
 soon we will announce a contest for the best photo taken in the demo, where the winner will get a steam card worth 100 USD, a key to our game and the photo will be considered to put on the game's loading screen 
Here we show you the parkour system of the character ,as he runs through the walls to reach his objetive,
the loot system that we have, consists of different types of chests, that we will find on the map where we can acquire potions, weapons and so on 
The checkpoint system,, that we have consists of unlocked areas, that when you pass through it automatically saves the game
And now talking about the detection of proximity of enemies, which is used for stealthy methods to eliminate enemies and conserve potions, in addition to avoiding being discovered in different missions.
In combat each weapon influences the gameplay so be careful which weapon you keep busy
Executions will always be the last hit on the enemy, or when they are executed stealthily
The boss is a stronger enemy and with a greater difficulty to defeat him lets see if you guys can kill him!!
This would be all !! a demo with an uncontested ending. Leave us your comments, join our discord so that you can give us feedback and thank you very much for reading this letter
